title: eludite.forge.detect input
description: Which forge the workspace repository's remote lives on (`forge.detect`): from the remote's url and the `forge.hosts` setting, with a version probe (`/api/v4/version` for GitLab, `/api/v1/version` for Forgejo and Gitea) for a host neither names. Answers the family, host, owner and repository, the signed-in account (from the credential store; nothing is fetched to know it) and the capabilities. Runs when a window opens or a command asks, never at startup. Read.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).

url.description: Detect this url instead of the workspace's remote.

probe.description: Allow the version probe for an unknown host (default true; one request, cached).
